title: Which scale breaks quarkonium? A controlled comparison of density and momentum relaxation in holographic QCD
summary: In a quark-gluon plasma (QGP) that is both dense and dissipative, do static color screening and thermodynamic response follow the same medium scale? The question matters because heavy-quark observables are routinely used to infer QGP properties, yet in a background with only finite density, or only momentum relaxation, the two scales cannot be compared: one of them is absent. We use the Einstein-Maxwell-axion geometry, in which the chemical potential $μ$ and the translational-symmetry-breaking parameter $β$ enter as independent controls, to carry out this comparison at fixed temperature.
